description:
The Firmstrong Bella Fashionista 3-Speed is a stylish and high-performing cruiser bike designed for riders who want to combine effortless functionality with a bold personal statement. This model is equipped with premium features including high-quality painted wheels, front and rear fenders, and a sleek frame design that offers a sophisticated look for the beach or the city. With the added capability of three gears, the Bella Fashionista provides much more versatility than a traditional single-speed cruiser while maintaining its elegant, uncluttered aesthetic.

The three-speed internal gear system is manufactured by Shimano and is widely recognized as one of the most reliable and user-friendly setups available. Because all the shifting occurs inside the rear hub, the chain never needs to move between sprockets to change gears, which significantly reduces maintenance and potential mechanical issues. Shifting is exceptionally smooth and seamless, even allowing you to change speeds without interrupting your pedal stroke. While the system remains simple with only three gears, it provides the perfect range for recreational riding. Gear one offers low resistance for easy hill climbing, gear two is ideal for steady cruising at five to fifteen miles per hour, and gear three provides the resistance needed to reach higher speeds on flat ground or downhill stretches.

Designed with a single-cable system, the Bella Fashionista keeps its streamlined appearance without the clutter of extra wires. The ride is consistently soft and comfortable thanks to the wide cruiser tires and dual-spring saddle that effectively absorb the shock from uneven pavement. For braking, the bike uses a classic coaster brake system where you simply pedal backwards to stop, maintaining the intuitive feel of an original beach cruiser. Built with a durable frame and an ergonomic upright riding position, the Bella Fashionista 3-Speed is the ideal upgrade for the fashion-forward rider who wants a high-quality, dependable bike that looks as good as it performs.

15” Steel Frame with 26” Aluminum Wheels

Three Speed Bike with a Pedal-Backwards Coaster Brake for easy pedaling and smooth braking

Dual Spring Oversized Cruiser Seat for Added Comfort

2.125” Wide White-Wall Tires provides a cushioned, relaxed ride for easy rolling

Front and Rear Fenders with a Cruiser Bend Style Handlebar

Bicycle Weighs 38lbs. Fully Assembled

Fits Most Girls and Women 5'2 - 6' Tall­

Recommended Riding Speed 3 – 15mph

Recommended Riding Distance 0 – 40 miles in a single trip

The Seat and Handlebar Height and Tilt can be adjusted to properly fit the rider

Bike comes 85% Assembled, Assembly is easy and fun!

Designed in Hermosa Beach, CA.
